company_description: For more than 40 years, DAVA Foods has been a trusted supplier of eggs and egg-based solutions to the food industry. With strong roots in agriculture and a deep understanding of the entire value chain, from farm to finished product, we have built our reputation on quality, food safety and long-term partnerships. Today, we are taking the next step in that journey. Through DAVA Biosolutions, we are exploring the untapped potential within the egg, transforming natural components into functional ingredients that help food manufacturers improve product quality, preservation and performance. By combining our extensive egg expertise with advanced processing technologies, we create bioactive protein ingredients that deliver value far beyond traditional egg products. Our ambition is clear: to unlock more from the egg and develop a growing portfolio of high-value ingredients for the food industry. From naturally derived enzymes such as lysozyme to future ingredient innovations (ovotransferrin and ovalbumin), we are focused on creating solutions that support both product quality and resource efficiency. What sets us apart is our integrated approach. Leveraging decades of experience in egg production, food safety and processing, we operate within a controlled value chain that provides security of supply, traceability and consistently high quality. Alongside our biosolutions portfolio, we will also be presenting selected plant-based ingredients, including innovative pulse-based products, supporting our ambition to offer a broader range of functional food solutions. Visit us to learn how DAVA Foods and DAVA Biosolutions are transforming natural raw materials into the next generation of food ingredients.

company_description: FABUMIN – The Functional, Clean-Label Egg Replacement for Food Professionals Overview FABUMIN is an advanced, plant-based egg alternative designed to meet the strict functional, formulation, and operational requirements of food technologists and product developers. It delivers egg-like performance in foaming, binding, and emulsifying—without the allergens, cost volatility, or handling complexity associated with animal-based ingredients. Key Functionalities Foaming: Provides excellent volume and aeration for light textures, ideal for meringues, macarons, sponge cakes, and whipped desserts. Binding: Offers strong internal cohesion for structured products like cookies, muffins, and plant-based meat analogs. Emulsifying: Enables stable phase inversion emulsions, producing smooth, shelf-stable sauces, vegan mayonnaise, and dressings. Industrial Advantages FABUMIN integrates easily into existing production processes without requiring any major equipment modifications. It is delivered in a dry, shelf-stable format with a long shelf life, allowing for accurate dosing, minimal waste, and consistent batch-to-batch performance. Its versatility across applications makes it an ideal solution for companies seeking to simplify SKUs and streamline sourcing. Economic & Operational Benefits With egg prices in the EU increasing by over 30% between 2022 and 2023—driven by avian flu and supply chain disruptions—FABUMIN offers a stable, cost-effective alternative. It helps reduce overall formulation costs while delivering the same sensory and structural outcomes as conventional eggs. Its dry format also reduces dependency on cold-chain logistics and lowers storage costs. Clean-Label & Regulatory Fit FABUMIN is a single-ingredient, clean-label solution free from common allergens, GMOs, cholesterol, and saturated fats. It supports product development that meets today’s consumer expectations for transparent, sustainable, and ethical ingredients. Whether targeting vegan, kosher, allergen-free, or environmentally conscious markets, FABUMIN aligns with evolving regulatory and marketing demands. Sustainability & Health In addition to being free from animal components, FABUMIN has a significantly lower environmental footprint compared to eggs in terms of water usage, land use, and carbon emissions. It is non-GMO and suitable for a wide range of dietary needs, including vegan and flexitarian consumers. Its high protein content and clean nutritional profile enhance both health appeal and labeling simplicity. company_description: Hainan Enneas Technology Co.,Ltd was established in July 1999. It is a high-tech enterprise dedicating to entire industrial chain of large-scale aloe cultivation, processing, purification and R&D of organic Aloe vera for nearly 27 years. In order to better meet raw material market demands and expand into end consumer product，the company invested CNY 200 million in 2019 to build a 30,000 square meter integrated park for aloe production and R8D. This park is located in the heart of Medicine Valley in Haikou City, Hainan Province. lt features a modern 16,000 square meter GMP production line and a world-class aloe joint research and development center. Our aloe cultivation and production processes strictly comply with organic production standards setby various regulatory bodies. These include the European Union's EU-EOS standards, Japan Organic Agriculture Standards (JAS), United States Department of Agriculture (USDA) Organic Regulations United States Food and Drug Administration (FDA), HACCP regulations for fruit and vegetable juice products, FSSC22000, PAS220 regulations, as well as the hygiene and safety registration regulations for exported food products in China. We have obtained certification for all of these mentioned standards. We have also been awarded the IASC certificate by the International Aloe Science Council. This serves as further evidence of the quality of our organic products.

company_description: What Is Theracurmin®? Turmeric has been used for centuries in Southeast Asia as a spice, flavoring, and coloring agent. The plant is known to have many health benefits. These properties of turmeric are largely thanks to curcumin, a polyphenol contained in turmeric. Communities of scientists and companies have created products with the objective of delivering the health benefits of the ingredient. However, clinical studies show that standard curcumin is not easily absorbed in the body despite large amounts of consumption. Theracurmin® was created to combat the low bioavailability and absorption of curcumin to harness the benefits of the natural ingredient.

company_description: Laboratoires Clémascience were founded in 2006 in Provence by Doctor of Pharmacy Laurent Didden, who is passionate about biology and medicine. His research led him to study more particularly the specificities of a hypoglycaemic plant : the apple, which became over the years the focus of all his attention. The detailed chromatography he performs allows him to sift through the entire fruit and discover more than 50 active ingredients. The apple then reveals itself to be an incredible source of polyphenols and fibres, essential to our health. Cultivating this specific expertise, the Research & Development department of Clémascience Laboratories, headed by Laurent Didden, develops unique complexes : Nutricibles®. By relying on pharmacological and kinetic research, the Clémascience teams became experts in Pomotherapy. Year after year, these exclusive Nutricibles® are developed in high added value health products. In just over 15 years, Laboratoires Clémascience has become THE multi-awarded specialist recognised for its expertise in polyphenols & fibres through unique and high-performance formulas. This is how they successfully support many major brands – in France and internationally – in the development of new products in the beauty and health sectors. Our manufacturing partners are rigorously selected to respect our values and standards of quality, safety and traceability. They are HACCP and GMP certified. The specificities of our formulas lead us to produce in several manufacturing sites in France.

company_description: LALLEMAND Lallemand is a global leader in fermentation-based solutions, developing, producing, and marketing yeast, bacteria, and other microorganisms to support innovation in food, health, agriculture, and industrial applications. With more than a century of experience, Lallemand combines science, innovation, and technical support to help customers create high-quality, sustainable products worldwide. At the booth: Lallemand Bio-Ingredients (LBI) operates as a division of Lallemand Inc., a privately-held Canadian company established in the late 19th century. Using strong research and development, proven results, and knowledge from experience, Lallemand Bio-Ingredients applies the right yeasts for the right applications to generate the greatest impact for our customers. Lallemand Bio-Ingredients is committed to partnering with customers to meet their specific requirements with key natural products and service solutions. Presently, our business unit encompasses various key application domains: Savory Ingredients: the expertise lies in utilizing yeast-derived ingredients within the realm of culinary applications. We excel in flavor characterization, texture, and nutritional aspects. Enzymes: Solyve is our new dedicated Food & Beverage enzymes business, backed by Lallemand’s fermentation expertise, providing enzyme solutions for baking ingredients, fruit processing, plant-based beverages & proteins and other food processes Aroma Ingredients: we offer aroma ingredients made through precision fermentation, a natural process that enables Lallemand to produce high-purity, natural ingredients while supporting a more efficient use of natural resources. Health Ingredients, we focus on dietary supplements and functional food applications Industrial Fermentation: we boost growth and yield of microorganisms in industrial environments. The multifaceted approach enables Lallemand Bio-Ingredients to cater to a broad spectrum of industries and requirements, ultimately driving innovation and customer satisfaction. Personal Care: we supply active ingredients for the development of personal care products Lallemand Specialty Cultures (LSC) develops and produces specialty cultures and microorganism-based solutions for dairy, meat, fish and plant-based applications. Our portfolio includes surface cultures, ripening cultures, starter cultures, and bioprotective solutions designed to support a wide variety of food products. As part of Lallemand, a global leader in fermentation-based solutions, LSC combines microbiology expertise, innovation, and technical support to help food manufacturers create distinctive products and ensure the uniqueness, quality, and safety of their products through meticulously selected microorganisms.

company_description: When Maypro was founded in 1977 by the Japanese entrepreneur Steve Yamada, it was a small company with a big vision — to improve human health and happiness by importing the best-quality nutraceutical ingredients and fine chemicals to the US market from Asia. At the time, the United States had the population to support massive growth of its fledgling dietary supplement industry, but suffered from a dearth of innovative ingredients. Japan, on the other hand, was developing groundbreaking nutraceuticals at breakneck speed, but its small population limited the ingredients’ growth potential. Maypro became the bridge between the two countries. Many of today’s specialty blockbuster ingredients — such as CoQ10, glucosamine, chondroitin sulfate and alpha lipoic acid — were first introduced from Japan to the US market by Maypro. As the United States started to develop proprietary, patented nutraceutical ingredients in the 1990s, the bridge became two-way, with Maypro pioneering the introduction of Citrimax®, Pycnogenol®, Tonalin®, Neopuntia® and Liposan Ultra® and many other products to the Japanese market. Today, Maypro has grown into one of the largest global suppliers of nutraceutical ingredients and fine chemicals, with six strategically located companies in the US, Japan and China and a global staff of over 100. We continue to build global bridges, expanding into Europe and Latin America, and now service hundreds of countries worldwide.

company_description: Promyc® is a 100% natural mycoprotein ingredient produced through fermentation. Combining high-quality protein, dietary fibre and excellent functionality, it helps food manufacturers create nutritious products with outstanding texture and taste. Thanks to its neutral flavour profile and unique fibrous structure, Promyc® is suitable for a wide range of applications including meat alternatives, hybrid meat products, high-protein snacks, sports nutrition products, dairy-free foods and protein-fortified recipes. As a sustainable fungal protein ingredient, Promyc® offers an innovative alternative to conventional protein sources, including whey protein and other animal- or plant-based proteins. It enables protein and fibre fortification in a single ingredient while maintaining consumer-friendly sensory properties. Produced in Belgium by Naplasol, part of the VEOS Group, Promyc® is manufactured at industrial scale through an efficient fermentation process capable of supplying thousands of tonnes annually. Our team supports food manufacturers throughout product development, from concept validation and prototyping to industrial implementation. company_description: MUSHEEZ® helps European food, beverage and food supplement companies source functional mushroom ingredients and bring finished products to market through flexible white label and private label production. Based in Estonia, MUSHEEZ® works with specialist cultivation, extraction and manufacturing partners, while managing ingredient selection, quality control, independent testing, documentation and practical project support. We support established brands, emerging companies, distributors, retailers, contract manufacturers and product developers. A client may come to MUSHEEZ® for a single bulk ingredient, a ready-to-sell white label product, a customised private label project, or support selecting the most appropriate mushroom material for a new formulation. WHITE LABEL AND PRIVATE LABEL FUNCTIONAL MUSHROOM PRODUCTS Available formats include: • Alcohol-free liquid mushroom extracts • Mushroom extract powders • Capsules • Tinctures • Functional mushroom formulations Typical starting minimum order quantities can be as low as 48 bottles for selected liquid products, 50 units for powders and 70 units for capsules or tinctures. White label provides a fast route to market using established products and packaging. Private label allows greater flexibility around formulation, ingredients, packaging and presentation, with minimum order quantities depending on the level of customisation. MUSHEEZ® can support the process from product and ingredient selection through manufacturing coordination, quality documentation and ongoing commercial supply. FUNCTIONAL MUSHROOM INGREDIENTS Our core species are: Lion’s Mane | Reishi | Chaga | Cordyceps CS-4 | Maitake | Shiitake Depending on the species and intended application, available formats include raw mushroom powders, processed 1:1 powders, concentrated water extracts, dual extracts and liquid ingredients. MUSHEEZ® does not believe that a larger extraction ratio automatically means a better ingredient. Selection should instead reflect what the client is making, the intended use level, processing requirements, regulatory position, sensory considerations and commercial objectives. This is particularly important because mushroom ingredients sold under the same common name can differ considerably in fungal material, production method, concentration, composition and intended use. PUREMUSHROOM™ VERIFIED INGREDIENTS PureMushroom™ is the MUSHEEZ® range for clients who want stronger evidence around ingredient identity, purity, composition and batch consistency. The range includes selected Lion’s Mane, Reishi, Chaga, Cordyceps CS-4, Maitake and Shiitake ingredients. Depending on the ingredient and batch, the MUSHEEZ® verification programme can include: • Nuclear Magnetic Resonance (NMR) identity analysis • Liquid Chromatography Mass Spectrometry Quadrupole Time-of-Flight (LC-MS-QTOF) compound profiling • Alpha-glucan and beta-glucan analysis • Microbiological testing • Heavy metals testing • Physical and functional testing PureMushroom™ ingredients are primarily based on the fruiting body. Chaga uses the conk, while PureCordyceps™ CS-4 is produced from fermented mycelium. Batch-level information is made available through PureData™, allowing clients to look beyond extraction ratios and supplier specification claims when comparing mushroom ingredients. SOLVIQA™ FOR FOOD AND BEVERAGE DEVELOPMENT SOLVIQA™ launches at Fi Europe 2026 and is being developed specifically for food and beverage applications. The range focuses on the practical behaviour of mushroom ingredients in formulations, not only their chemical specification. Initial SOLVIQA™ ingredients include selected Lion’s Mane, Reishi, Maitake and Shiitake extracts. Evaluation can include: • Water Solubility Index • Water-Holding Capacity • Oil-Holding Capacity • Dispersion behaviour • Sensory characteristics • Suitability for different food and beverage matrices This information can help research and development teams identify formulation issues earlier and select ingredients according to the actual application. Potential applications include ready-to-drink beverages, drink powders, hot drinks, savoury products and other functional foods. QUALITY CONTROL AND INDEPENDENT TESTING MUSHEEZ® combines specialist external manufacturing with its own quality control and verification programme. We distinguish clearly between information supplied by a manufacturer and analysis independently commissioned by MUSHEEZ®. Testing is selected according to the ingredient and the question that needs answering. No single analytical method provides every answer. For example, Nuclear Magnetic Resonance can provide strong evidence around chemical identity and composition, while Liquid Chromatography Mass Spectrometry Quadrupole Time-of-Flight can provide detailed compound profiling. Enzymatic methods are used for glucan analysis, while microbiological and heavy metals testing address different aspects of product safety and specification. For food and beverage projects, analytical data may also be combined with physical performance measurements and trained sensory evaluation. The objective is practical: to give procurement teams, product developers and brand owners better information about what they are buying and how an ingredient may perform. EUROPEAN REGULATORY AWARENESS Functional mushrooms do not all have the same regulatory position in the European Union. Suitability depends on factors including species, fungal material, processing method and intended application. Selected Lion’s Mane, Reishi, Maitake and Shiitake ingredients can be suitable for conventional food and food supplement applications. MUSHEEZ® supplies Chaga and Cordyceps CS-4 for food supplement use only. MUSHEEZ® therefore considers the intended product and market before recommending an ingredient route. PRACTICAL EUROPEAN SUPPORT MUSHEEZ® is built around making specialist mushroom sourcing and product development more accessible. Our model allows clients to work with a European team while drawing on specialist production capabilities from different manufacturing partners. This gives us flexibility to select production methods and suppliers according to the ingredient rather than requiring every project to fit one factory. MUSHEEZ® currently supports more than 60 brands across around 30 countries. Our clients include food supplement brands, functional food and beverage developers, distributors, contract manufacturers and retailers. RESEARCH AND TECHNICAL RESOURCES MUSHEEZ® publishes technical reports, articles and selected research openly to help improve transparency and decision-making within the functional mushroom industry. Topics include: • Functional mushroom extracts for food and beverage development • Mushroom extract quality and analytical transparency • The limitations of extraction ratios as quality indicators • Mushroom identity and Nuclear Magnetic Resonance testing • Glucan analysis • Dosage reporting in human mushroom studies • European regulatory considerations for individual mushroom materials Our free reports include Functional Mushroom Extracts for Food & Beverages and Elevating Mushroom Extract Quality: A Science-Driven Approach to Transparency and Efficacy. The current Ingredients Network profile already features both reports. company_description: At Natural Trace, we have pioneered a ground-breaking solution that revolutionizes product traceability. Our innovative approach directly tags products with a bio-barcode at the molecular level, overcoming the limitation of traditional packaging labels or barcodes. This cutting-edge technology ensures unprecedented supply chain visibility and control over products. Our 100% natural, food-grade, and non-GMO tags can be tested and detected at various points along the supply chain. This remarkable capability enables companies and consumers to have complete confidence in the provenance and safety of all food and beverage products. We empower growers, manufacturers, and retailers to increase transparency and assure authenticity like never before. Introducing our 3-Step Traceability Solution 1. NaturalTagTM is a 100% natural, inert, food-grade bio-barcode that is tasteless, invisible, and tamper-proof. This innovative tag is seamlessly integrated into products at the molecular level, ensuring unparalleled traceability and authenticity. 2. NaturalDetectTM is a targeted testing method that identifies your unique NaturalTag at any point along the supply chain. This powerful tool enables comprehensive monitoring and verification of product authenticity, ensuring the highest levels of quality and safety. 3. NaturalCloudTM is our digital surveillance platform that captures invaluable results and product data. This robust platform provides real-time insights on supply chain risks, enabling informed decision-making and ensuring complete supply chain surveillance. We are committed to safeguarding brand reputations, protecting IP and authenticating products to prevent counterfeiting. Chat to us today to find out more.

company_description: Naturmega is an advanced lipid science company specializing in the development and manufacturing of high-performance omega-3 ingredients for the global nutraceutical industry. With over 20 years of expertise, Naturmega offers a full spectrum of omega-3 solutions, from medium to ultra-high concentration fish oils to algae-based DHA and next-generation lipid platforms. The company is recognized for its ability to go beyond traditional omega-3 formats, enabling brands to develop more effective, stable, and consumer-friendly products. At the core of Naturmega’s differentiation is its proprietary approach to purification and lipid design. The company operates both molecular distillation and closed-loop supercritical CO₂ processing technologies, allowing for gentle, selective purification under low temperatures. This results in superior sensory performance, improved oxidative stability, and high levels of purity, addressing one of the biggest challenges in omega-3 supplementation: taste, odor, and overall consumer experience. Naturmega’s branded technologies include: EssentiOmega™, a range of high-quality fish oil concentrates EssentiOmega™ Nova powered by Senses™, ultra-pure, high-concentration omega-3 designed for optimal sensory performance Algalis®, a high-DHA algae omega-3 platform offering a clean, sustainable, and fish-free alternative Ruby-O® BPL-O3™, a next-generation bonded phospholipid omega-3 platform designed for enhanced absorption and targeted delivery Through these platforms, Naturmega supports applications across key health categories, including cardiovascular health, cognitive performance, prenatal and women’s health, visual health, and active nutrition. Headquartered in Barranquilla, Colombia, Naturmega benefits from a strategic location that enables efficient global sourcing and distribution, with a strong presence in the Americas, Europe, and Asia through its network of partners and distributors. More than a supplier, Naturmega acts as a strategic partner, combining science, technology, and market insight to help brands differentiate and succeed in an increasingly competitive omega-3 landscape.

company_description: Naveh Pharma Ltd. is a pharmaceutical company founded in 1996, specializing in advanced R&D, manufacturing, and distribution of pharmaceutical and healthcare products with unique characteristics. Postbiotics offer significant advantages over probiotics, enhancing gut microbiota, boosting immunity, protecting against diseases, supporting weight management, improving cognition, and more. Additionally, Naveh Pharma is actively involved in the development and production of patented Saffron-based supplements designed to balance mental health, treat depression, and support those with attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD). company_description: Packstyle is a forward-thinking company redefining flexible packaging through research, quality and continuous innovation. Our mission is to make high-performance packaging accessible and efficient, while constantly investing in material development, testing and regulatory compliance. Research & Development drives our evolution. We work on advanced high-barrier and recyclable structures, carry out in-depth performance testing and continuously adapt our solutions to meet the latest national and international food-contact regulations. Our approach is pioneering: we explore new materials, formats and technologies to combine protection, sustainability and design. We chose flexible packaging for its efficiency and reduced environmental impact. Lightweight and space-saving, it lowers transport emissions and helps reduce food waste by extending product shelf life. Every solution is engineered to protect product integrity while minimizing environmental footprint. Our range includes flat pouches and doypacks in multiple sizes. While we are known for short runs starting from 50 pieces, our production capacity also supports larger-scale industrial quantities, ensuring consistent quality and reliability. All materials are certified for food contact and designed with advanced barrier properties to protect against oxygen, moisture and light. We offer recyclable paper, metallised films and transparent films, officially certified (ATICELCA for paper and Interzero for films). To provide measurable and transparent data, Packstyle has conducted a Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) analysis on its materials. This scientific evaluation measures environmental impact throughout the entire life cycle, from raw material sourcing to end-of-life, allowing us to benchmark, improve and offer objective data to our clients. Functionality is enhanced by accessories such as resealable zippers for extended freshness and spouts for precise dispensing of liquid or powdered products. Each detail is designed to optimize usability and performance. Digital printing enables fast production, high-definition graphics and full customization without extra setup costs. We manage both small and large runs with short lead times, including multi-graphic productions at no additional charge. Artwork can be uploaded independently or developed with our in-house creative team through the Style My Pack service. At Packstyle, flexibility means innovation, measurable sustainability and industrial-quality performance, supporting brands that seek reliable, forward-looking packaging solutions.

company_description: Paradise Fruits Freeze Dried (Paradiesfrucht GmbH) is a young, dynamic company that has emerged as an industry leader in the field of freeze-drying both with Germany, and around the world. We pride ourselves in providing an extensive range of quality freeze-dried ingredients and flexible solutions for industrial applications including contract drying. With state-of-the-art facilities and expanding capability, we offer continuity of supply and quality assurance. Our freeze-dried fruit contains no additives: just 100 % pure tasty fruit. Freeze-drying is a process where frozen raw materials are placed in a refrigerated vacuum and ice crystals in the product are sublimated into water vapour, while the cell structure of the original product remains. Although freeze-dried fruits are small and light-weight, studies show that the antioxidant phytochemicals found in the fruits’ fresh state are retained at levels almost as high after freeze-drying.

company_description: Shaping the Future of Nutraceuticals For 20 years, Parkacre has been at the forefront of the nutraceutical industry. Founded in 2004, we are the largest fully integrated UK manufacturer of vitamins, minerals, and supplements. Our vision is to shape the future of nutraceuticals through market-leading innovation, quality, and collaborative partnerships. We specialize in producing the highest quality tablets, capsules, gummies, and powder blends, manufacturing innovative health products for the world’s leading brands and exporting to over 50 countries worldwide. Innovation at Our Core Our 2,000 square-meter Innovation Centre enables our expert scientists to consistently lead the way in new product development. We have developed over 5,000 unique formulations from more than 500 globally sourced ingredients. We have expertise in various product formats, including tablets, capsules, gummies, softgels, and powder blends. Through collaborative partnerships, we develop and manufacture customer-specific formulations, packaging them in recycled plastic/glass bottles, blister packs, tubs, pouches, and powder sachets. World-Class Manufacturing Our UK-based, state-of-the-art cleanroom manufacturing facility spans over 120,000 square feet. It can produce more than 10 billion tablets, capsules, sachets, and gummies, processing over 5,000 tonnes of raw material annually. Our meticulous attention to detail, combined with a commitment to using only the finest ingredients, ensures that every product leaving our facility meets the highest standards. From concept to final product, we strive for excellence in all that we do. At Parkacre, we are committed to long-term environmental care, recognizing that today’s choices impact future generations. We have embraced green manufacturing, utilizing 100% renewable energy to power our cleanrooms and offices, significantly reducing our carbon footprint. Parkacre Brands Our remarkable range of branded products caters to various market segments. We continuously develop our brands, expanding into new markets. Vangard Sports delivers affordable, high-quality sports nutrition for dedicated fitness enthusiasts. Nature's Care offers premium, general health products for the mass market. We are also brand partners with Paramount Pictures, offering an exciting Nickelodeon range featuring beloved characters like SpongeBob SquarePants, PAW Patrol, and Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles. Our Commitment Our impressive credentials and experience demonstrate why we are renowned as high-quality supplement manufacturers, dedicated to providing unparalleled quality, reliability, and excellence. We earn your trust at every step. With our passion for excellence, Parkacre can create truly unique products for your business and customers, or you can join us on an exciting journey as a trusted brand partner.

company_description: Pacifico Biolabs, founded in November 2022 in Berlin, is a meat company, making indistinguishable ‘chicken’ and other white meats using mycelium and beer brewing fermenters. We have other ‘white meat’ products in our pipeline such as pork and white fish.
Global ingredients and nutraceutical supplier.

Packtin’s flours are not just very tasty, they also keep intact all the flavours and bioactive compounds of the original raw materials, without adding additives, colourants or preservatives. They are obtained through an innovative and circular cold-drying process, optimised to guarantee the utmost quality and sustainability, to benefit the environment and future generations.
